en.title: Seven things pilots say make the Boeing 737 a unique jet to fly
en.summary: From a manual-first design philosophy to exposed main-gear wheels and audible trim wheels, the Boeing 737 retains mechanical flying characteristics that newer airliners have largely automated, dividing pilot opinion.
body: The Boeing 737 has been repeatedly updated since the late 1960s, yet it retains characteristics that have become unusual in modern commercial aviation, and pilots who have flown both Boeing and Airbus narrowbodies notice the difference most in the feel of the controls. The first is a manual-first philosophy: Boeing has traditionally kept a more direct relationship between the pilot and several aircraft systems, allowing crews to see, hear, and physically feel things that newer aircraft increasingly handle through automation, even though the 737 MAX has a thoroughly modern flight deck. Qantas pilots transitioning from the 737 to the Airbus A321XLR leave behind traditional control columns for fly-by-wire sidesticks and flight envelope protection, a change that requires a full type rating rather than simply learning a different arrangement of cockpit buttons.

The remaining characteristics all express that visible, physical connection. The 737 sits unusually low, and unlike most modern commercial aircraft it has no conventional doors covering its main landing gear wheels when retracted; instead the wheels remain partially exposed, with hubs and rubber seals forming the visible outer surface. Pitch trim also demands more manual involvement on the 737 MAX than on many newer aircraft, where automatic trim is integrated into the flight control system. The autothrottle physically drives the thrust levers forward and backward as required thrust changes, so crews can see and feel the automation working. Beside each pilot's knees sit two large stabilizer trim wheels that rotate, often with a distinctive mechanical whirring or rattling sound, and can be grabbed and operated manually. If both main hydraulic systems fail, manual reversion preserves a cable connection to the ailerons and elevators, letting the crew retain control at much greater physical effort. Underpinning all of it is the traditional yoke, connected through cables and pulleys to the flight control surfaces, in contrast to Airbus sidesticks whose inputs travel electronically to flight control computers.

facts.claim: Boeing has traditionally kept a more direct relationship between the pilot and several aircraft systems on the 737, and the 737 MAX retains fundamental design choices made decades ago despite a modern flight deck.
Qantas pilots moving from the 737 to the Airbus A321XLR leave traditional control columns for fly-by-wire sidesticks and flight envelope protection, requiring a full type rating.
The 737 has no conventional doors covering its main landing gear wheels when retracted; the wheels remain partially exposed, with hubs and rubber seals forming the visible outer surface.
The 737 MAX retains more manual involvement in pitch trim, its autothrottle physically moves the thrust levers, and its two large stabilizer trim wheels rotate audibly and can be operated manually.

After losing both main hydraulic systems, the 737's manual reversion preserves a cable connection to the ailerons and elevators, and its traditional yoke connects through cables and pulleys rather than electronic sidestick inputs.

zh.title: 飛行員眼中波音737與眾不同的7個駕駛特點
zh.summary: 從手動優先的設計哲學到外露的主起落架輪胎與可聽見的配平輪，波音737保留了許多現代客機已少見的機械操作特徵，也讓飛行員對它的駕駛感受評價兩極。
body: 波音737自1960年代末問世以來歷經多次更新，但仍保留了一些在現代民航機上已相當少見的特徵，也因此在飛行員之間形成鮮明的駕駛感受。文章列出的7個特點，從整體的手動優先設計哲學出發：波音傳統上讓飛行員與多個系統保持更直接的關係，能看見、聽見並實際感受到許多新機型已交由自動化處理的環節；即使737MAX已擁有相當現代化的駕駛艙，數十年前的基本設計選擇仍清晰可見。從737轉換至空中巴士A321XLR的澳洲航空飛行員，便必須放下傳統駕駛桿，改用線傳飛控側桿與飛航包線保護，兩種機型需要完整的機型檢定，而不只是學習不同的按鈕配置。

其餘特點都圍繞著這種可見、可感的機械連結：737機身位置較低，主起落架輪胎在收起後仍部分外露，輪轂與橡膠密封圈構成起落架外表面；相較於許多新機型把配平整合進飛控系統，737MAX仍讓飛行員在俯仰配平上有更多手動參與。自動油門作動時會實際推動油門桿前後移動，飛行員手放在桿上就能感受到推力變化；駕駛員膝旁的兩具大型水平尾翼配平輪，會隨著配平調整而轉動並發出機械聲響，必要時還能直接以手操作。即使兩套主液壓系統都失效，737仍可透過鋼索以手動回復方式操作副翼與升降舵，雖然操縱會費力許多，但仍能保有控制能力。最根本的一點，是737仍使用傳統駕駛桿，透過鋼索與滑輪與飛控面相連，不同於空中巴士以側桿透過電子訊號傳給飛控電腦；也正是這套機械連結，解釋了前述多項特徵為何至今仍然存在。
